title: Weekly Cooking Club
description: Five people in a weekly cooking club in New Orleans, connected through culinary partnerships, neighborhood ties, restaurant work, and family bonds. Rich in food traditions, career details, and cultural exchange.

people.name: Marcus Thibodaux
people.role: Head chef at a Cajun restaurant, cooking club founder
people.profile: Third-generation Cajun cook from Lafayette. Trained at the Culinary Institute of America. Runs the weekly cooking club out of his home kitchen on Frenchmen Street.

observations.text: Marcus Thibodaux is the head chef at Bayou Table, a Cajun restaurant on Magazine Street in New Orleans.
Marcus Thibodaux grew up in Lafayette, Louisiana, where his grandmother ran a roadside boudin stand.
Marcus Thibodaux founded the Wednesday Night Cooking Club in January 2023, hosting it in his home kitchen on Frenchmen Street.
Marcus Thibodaux and Priya Nair are co-workers at Bayou Table, where Priya is the pastry chef.
Marcus Thibodaux graduated from the Culinary Institute of America in Hyde Park, New York, in 2010.
Marcus Thibodaux won the 2023 New Orleans Gumbo Festival competition with his duck and andouille gumbo.
Marcus Thibodaux and Rosa Delgado are next-door neighbors on Frenchmen Street.
Marcus Thibodaux's specialty is a 48-hour slow-cooked pork shoulder with cane syrup glaze.
Marcus Thibodaux drives a black 2021 Ford F-150 with a custom license plate that reads ROUX-BOY.
Marcus Thibodaux's father, Jean-Pierre, still makes boudin at the family stand in Lafayette every Saturday.
Marcus Thibodaux spent three weeks in Lyon, France, last February training under Chef Michel Girard at a Michelin-starred restaurant.
Marcus Thibodaux keeps a collection of over 200 hot sauce bottles in his garage, organized by Scoville rating.
Marcus Thibodaux taught a crawfish boil masterclass at the New Orleans Food and Wine Festival in April 2024.
Marcus Thibodaux has a 12-year-old daughter named Celine who attends Lusher Charter School.
Marcus Thibodaux is writing a cookbook called 'Frenchmen Street Kitchen' with recipes from the cooking club.
Marcus Thibodaux smokes his own tasso ham using a custom-built smoker in his backyard.
Marcus Thibodaux broke his left thumb while shucking oysters at a charity event last September and was in a splint for four weeks.
Marcus Thibodaux runs three miles along the Mississippi River levee every morning at 5:30 AM.
Marcus Thibodaux and Hideo Tanaka are cooking partners in the club, specializing in Cajun-Japanese fusion dishes.
Marcus Thibodaux donated 500 meals to the St. Bernard Project after Hurricane Francine in September 2024.

people.name: Priya Nair
people.role: Pastry chef at Bayou Table, baking instructor
people.profile: Born in Chennai, India, moved to New Orleans for culinary school. Expert in French pastry with South Indian flavor twists. Teaches weekend baking classes at a community center.

observations.text: Priya Nair is the pastry chef at Bayou Table, where she works alongside head chef Marcus Thibodaux.
Priya Nair was born in Chennai, India, and moved to New Orleans in 2016 to attend the New Orleans Culinary and Hospitality Institute.
Priya Nair's signature dessert is a cardamom-praline bread pudding that has been featured in Eater New Orleans.
Priya Nair teaches a Saturday morning baking class at the Tremé Community Center.
Priya Nair and Rosa Delgado are cooking partners in the Wednesday Night Cooking Club, focusing on desserts and pastries.
Priya Nair won second place at the 2024 King Cake Festival with a masala chai king cake.
Priya Nair's mother, Lakshmi, sends her homemade curry powder from Chennai every three months by international post.
Priya Nair adopted a tabby cat named Masala from the Louisiana SPCA in March 2024.
Priya Nair lives in a shotgun house on Esplanade Avenue, three blocks from the French Quarter.
Priya Nair speaks Tamil, Hindi, and English fluently, and is learning Cajun French from Marcus.
Priya Nair ran her first 10K at the Crescent City Classic in April 2024 with a time of 58 minutes.
Priya Nair's favorite cookbook is 'Tartine Bread' by Chad Robertson.
Priya Nair is developing a line of South Indian-inspired pralines to sell at the French Market.
Priya Nair visited her family in Chennai for two weeks during Diwali 2023 and brought back 10 kilograms of spices.
Priya Nair drives a red 2022 Kia Soul with a bumper sticker that says 'Bakers Gonna Bake'.
Priya Nair's favorite ingredient to work with is jaggery, an unrefined cane sugar from India.
Priya Nair organized a Diwali potluck at the cooking club in November 2024, where she taught everyone to make murukku.
Priya Nair does yoga at Swan River Yoga on Magazine Street every weekday at 7 AM.
Priya Nair's dream is to open her own bakery in the Bywater neighborhood specializing in Indo-Creole pastries.
Priya Nair catered desserts for a 300-person Mardi Gras ball hosted by the Krewe of Muses in February 2024.

people.name: Rosa Delgado
people.profile: Mexican-American, grew up in Veracruz. Moved to New Orleans 20 years ago. Known for her mole sauces and tamales. Teaches fourth grade at a public school in the Seventh Ward.

observations.text: Rosa Delgado teaches fourth grade at William Frantz Elementary School in the Seventh Ward.
Rosa Delgado grew up in Veracruz, Mexico, and moved to New Orleans in 2004 after marrying her husband Carlos.
Rosa Delgado and Marcus Thibodaux are next-door neighbors on Frenchmen Street.
Rosa Delgado and Priya Nair are cooking partners in the Wednesday Night Cooking Club, focusing on desserts and pastries.
Rosa Delgado's seven-ingredient mole negro takes three days to prepare and uses chocolate from Oaxaca.
Rosa Delgado won Teacher of the Year at William Frantz Elementary in 2023.
Rosa Delgado's husband Carlos works as a welder at Avondale Shipyard.
Rosa Delgado has three children: Sofia (16), Miguel (13), and Luna (9).
Rosa Delgado makes 300 tamales every December for the cooking club's holiday sale, donating proceeds to Second Harvest Food Bank.
Rosa Delgado and Hideo Tanaka carpooled together for six months in 2024 because Hideo's car was in the shop.
Rosa Delgado grows habanero, serrano, and guajillo peppers in her backyard garden on Frenchmen Street.
Rosa Delgado traveled to Oaxaca with her mother in July 2024 to learn traditional mole recipes from her aunt Elena.
Rosa Delgado speaks Spanish and English fluently and translates for Spanish-speaking parents at her school.
Rosa Delgado's favorite cookbook is 'My Mexico City Kitchen' by Gabriela Camara.
Rosa Delgado drives a white 2019 Honda CR-V with a Virgen de Guadalupe air freshener.
Rosa Delgado organized a Dia de los Muertos celebration at the cooking club in November 2024, building an ofrenda with photos and marigolds.
Rosa Delgado takes a Zumba class at the YMCA on St. Charles Avenue every Monday and Wednesday evening.
Rosa Delgado's daughter Sofia helps her prep tamale filling on weekends and wants to attend culinary school.
Rosa Delgado baked 150 conchas for a fundraiser at her school that raised $2,400 for new playground equipment.
Rosa Delgado introduced the cooking club to agua de jamaica and now it is the official club drink, served every Wednesday.

people.name: Hideo Tanaka
people.profile: Born in Osaka, Japan. Trained at a sushi restaurant in Tokyo for seven years before moving to New Orleans. Fascinated by the overlap between Japanese and Creole seafood traditions.

observations.text: Hideo Tanaka is the head sushi chef at Kura, a Japanese restaurant in the Warehouse District of New Orleans.
Hideo Tanaka was born in Osaka, Japan, and trained for seven years at a sushi restaurant in Tsukiji, Tokyo.
Hideo Tanaka and Marcus Thibodaux are cooking partners in the club, specializing in Cajun-Japanese fusion dishes.
Hideo Tanaka and Rosa Delgado carpooled together for six months in 2024 because Hideo's car was in the shop.
Hideo Tanaka moved to New Orleans in 2019 because he wanted to explore the connection between Japanese and Creole seafood traditions.
Hideo Tanaka created a miso-crawfish roll that became the best-selling item at Kura in 2024.
Hideo Tanaka and Lorraine Baptiste are cousins by marriage — Hideo's wife Yuki and Lorraine's husband Jerome are first cousins.
Hideo Tanaka's wife Yuki teaches Japanese language classes at Tulane University.
Hideo Tanaka won Best Fusion Dish at the 2024 New Orleans Wine and Food Experience for his shiso-debris po'boy.
Hideo Tanaka imports his knives directly from a bladesmith in Sakai, Japan, and owns a set worth over $5,000.
Hideo Tanaka goes fishing for redfish and speckled trout in the Bienvenue Triangle marsh every other Sunday morning.
Hideo Tanaka visited his parents in Osaka for two weeks during Golden Week in May 2024.
Hideo Tanaka taught a sashimi knife skills workshop at the cooking club in August 2024, using yellowfin tuna from the Gulf.
Hideo Tanaka speaks Japanese and English, and has picked up conversational Spanish from Rosa Delgado.
Hideo Tanaka lives in a duplex on Chartres Street in the Bywater neighborhood.
Hideo Tanaka makes his own dashi from scratch every morning at Kura using dried bonito flakes and kombu seaweed.
Hideo Tanaka's three-year-old son Kenji attends the same preschool as Marcus's niece.
Hideo Tanaka placed third in the 2024 Louisiana Seafood Cook-Off with his Japanese-style grilled oysters.
Hideo Tanaka drives a silver 2020 Subaru Outback that was in the repair shop for six months after an engine issue.
Hideo Tanaka ferments his own rice vinegar in ceramic crocks he brought from Osaka.

people.name: Lorraine Baptiste
people.profile: Born and raised in New Orleans Seventh Ward. Creole heritage going back six generations. Known for her red beans and rice and pralines. Retired from Ochsner Medical Center after 25 years.

observations.text: Lorraine Baptiste retired from Ochsner Medical Center in 2022 after 25 years as a registered nurse in the cardiac unit.
Lorraine Baptiste was born and raised in the Seventh Ward of New Orleans, in a Creole family that has lived there for six generations.
Lorraine Baptiste and Hideo Tanaka are cousins by marriage — her husband Jerome and Hideo's wife Yuki are first cousins.
Lorraine Baptiste is the oldest member of the Wednesday Night Cooking Club and brings her grandmother's cast-iron pot to every session.
Lorraine Baptiste's red beans and rice recipe uses pickled pork from Langenstein's and a secret blend of seven spices.
Lorraine Baptiste and Priya Nair take the same yoga class at Swan River Yoga on Magazine Street every weekday morning.
Lorraine Baptiste's husband Jerome is a retired firefighter who now builds custom furniture.
Lorraine Baptiste won the praline category at the 2024 Creole Tomato Festival with her bourbon-pecan pralines.
Lorraine Baptiste has four grandchildren and babysits them every Friday at her house on North Claiborne Avenue.
Lorraine Baptiste traveled to Paris in October 2024 to take a two-week French pastry course at Le Cordon Bleu.
Lorraine Baptiste drives a gold 2017 Cadillac Escalade that she calls 'Big Mama'.
Lorraine Baptiste organized the cooking club's Juneteenth celebration in 2024, preparing a traditional Creole feast for 40 guests.
Lorraine Baptiste speaks English and Louisiana Creole French, and can read standard French.
Lorraine Baptiste's favorite cookbook is 'Leah Chase: The Queen of Creole Cuisine' by Leah Chase.
Lorraine Baptiste makes a batch of seafood gumbo with okra every Monday and delivers portions to three elderly neighbors.
Lorraine Baptiste taught Marcus Thibodaux how to make proper Creole roux when he first moved to New Orleans.
Lorraine Baptiste grows herbs — basil, thyme, oregano, and bay laurel — in raised beds she built with her husband Jerome.
Lorraine Baptiste donated 200 pralines to a bake sale at the Tremé Community Center in September 2024, raising $1,800.
Lorraine Baptiste's granddaughter Amara, age 8, has started joining the cooking club and is learning to make biscuits.
Lorraine Baptiste was interviewed by WWNO public radio about Creole food traditions in August 2024.

chain_examples.description: Marcus works with Priya at Bayou Table -> Priya is Rosa's cooking partner in the club -> Rosa carpooled with Hideo for six months -> Hideo is Lorraine's cousin by marriage -> Lorraine taught Marcus to make proper Creole roux
chain_examples.example_question: The person who is cousins by marriage with Rosa's carpool partner — what award did she win at the Creole Tomato Festival?
chain_examples.answer: Lorraine Baptiste won the praline category at the 2024 Creole Tomato Festival with her bourbon-pecan pralines.
reasoning_steps: Rosa's carpool partner is Hideo Tanaka (rosa_010, hideo_004)
Hideo's cousin by marriage is Lorraine Baptiste (hideo_007, lorraine_003)
Lorraine won the praline category at the 2024 Creole Tomato Festival (lorraine_008)
